notes.title: EXODIUM Part 1 — new demo version
notes.notes:
The new EXODIUM demo opens the beginning of Chapter Two. This time, together with special forces captain Melissa Novak, you must pass through the dark corridors of the Security Complex — once guarded by soldiers… until they became infected and enslaved by another will.
In this demo you will find:
The first steps of Melissa’s storyline, where exploration gradually turns into a deadly confrontation.

Encounters with former defenders who now resemble nightmares from a biological report more than soldiers.

An atmosphere of silence, interrupted by sudden bursts of action.

New environmental details and refinements based on your feedback.

In the demo you can discover journals revealing the first details of what happened in the Complex, face enemies who were once human, and experience the tension of survival in a closed environment.
